title: Porous zeolitic imidazolate framework-67@CeVO4 hybrid composite with enhanced ion diffusion kinetics for high-performance energy storage devices
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6SE00148C, Paper
Navaneeth Kumar Ravikumar, Panneerselvam Perumal
Hierarchical ZIF-67@CeVO4 integrates porous MOF architecture with redox-active CeVO4, enabling rapid ion transport, enhanced charge storage, and outstanding cycling stability for advanced energy storage devices.
